products.title: Advance Teeth Whitening Serum (30 ml)
products.body_html:
Whiten Your Teeth in Just 3–4 Minutes

Get a noticeably brighter smile from the very first use — no strips, no trays, no waiting weeks. Perfect for last-minute plans, video calls, dates, or important meetings.

Why Habbits Whitening Serum?

  • Peroxide-Free & Enamel-Safe — Unlike traditional whitening kits, this formula is gentle enough for daily use, even on sensitive teeth.
  • Natural Ingredients — Powered by activated charcoal, tricalcium phosphate, and peppermint oil to remove surface stains from coffee, tea, wine, and smoking while freshening breath.
  • No Parabens, No Sulfates, No Artificial Whiteners — Clean formula you can trust.
  • Made in India | Vegan & Cruelty-Free — Proudly formulated in India with premium quality standards. Not tested on animals.

How to Use (4 Easy Steps)

  1. Paint the serum on your teeth using the built-in brush.
  2. Wait 3–4 minutes.
  3. Brush normally.
  4. Rinse. Done.

Travel-friendly 30 ml tube. Ideal for both men and women.
